usedFor: Moco holds offers, purchases and leads for agencies, and HubSpot receives a deal from “New Offer” through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Offer” in Moco, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new offer is where a deal starts, and the action creates it in HubSpot.

watchOut: “New Offer” in Moco is polling, so “Create Deal” runs after a scheduled check and a short delay is normal.
